newsitem.title: USA: Gibbs Construction changes warrant plan.
newsitem.headline: Gibbs Construction changes warrant plan.

text.p: Gibbs Construction Inc said Friday that its two largest stockholders will no longer be issued warrants for four million shares of the company's common stock.
The only warrants that will now be exercised, it said, are those that allow Danny and Tony Gibbs to remain in control of the company.

"The previous structure was not beneficial for our stockholders or for Tony and me," Danny Gibbs said in a statement. "With such a large number of warrants outstanding, the potential dilution to our stockholder would have been too great."
Danny Gibbs said the tax consequences also had the potential to be "disruptive in the market because we would probably be required to sell stock to create liquidity."
Instead, the company said it will declare a dividend of one million shares of its common stock to holders of record on October 18.
The Gibbs brothers are excluded from the dividend, which is to be paid out on November 1.
The dividend will be paid after the Gibbs exchange one million shares of the company's common stock for warrants to purchase two million shares of common stock at $0.10 per share.
